title: Chewing Gum
description: This mod adds a pack of gums with 3 pieces inside used to remove nausea
body:
This mod adds a **Chewing Gum** pack with 3 gums inside, it's used to remove nausea and only nausea.
When the pack is empty it becomes an empty **wrap** that you can smelt to get an **aluminum ball** (you can throw it)
When you craft the aluminum ball with cocoa beans, you get a chocolate ball (but don't forget there's still the aluminum ball inside)

Crafting recipes:
